description: Texts a 6-digit code to the mobile number given in create_setup (never to any other number). Tell the person a text is coming and ask them to read the code to you, then call confirm_phone_code. Call again only if it has not arrived after a minute; each setup gets 3 codes.

status_token.description: status_token from create_setup. Keep it private.

name: send_phone_code
title: Text the person a confirmation code
